The '''Bettel system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Yarith sector/Legends|Yarith sector]], a region of the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Bettel asteroid drift]].
